command:
set -eo pipefail
cd /tmp
echo "== bedtools genomecov on bwa's whole-genome BAM: 48,817,006 records, 4.5 GB =="
df -m /tmp | awk 'NR==2{print "tmpfs_total_mb "$2}'
( MAX=0; while :; do U=$(df -m /tmp | awk 'NR==2{print $3}')
    [ "$U" -gt "$MAX" ] && { MAX=$U; echo "$MAX" > /tmp/.peak; }; sleep 2; done ) & SAMPLER=$!

T0=$(date +%s)
bedtools genomecov -ibam aln.sorted.bam > genomecov.txt
T1=$(date +%s); WALL=$(( T1 - T0 ))
kill "$SAMPLER" 2>/dev/null || true
PEAK=$(cat /tmp/.peak 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
# Never rm a staged input: sticky /tmp + stage-in as the instance user means EPERM, which `rm -f`
# does not suppress and which would kill the task under set -e.

# genomecov writes <contig> <depth> <bases_at_that_depth> <contig_len> <fraction>, plus aggregate
# rows keyed "genome". Bases run to 3e9, so every sum uses %.0f -- awk's %d is int32 and would
# clamp at 2147483647, silently corrupting the conservation check.
GEN=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="genome"{s+=$3} END{printf "%.0f", s}' genomecov.txt)
PER=$(awk -F'\t' '$1!="genome"{s+=$3} END{printf "%.0f", s}' genomecov.txt)
# The reference's own index is the independent authority on contig lengths.
FAI=$(awk -F'\t' '{s+=$2} END{printf "%.0f", s}' GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.fa.fai)
CONTIGS=$(awk -F'\t' 'END{print NR}' GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.fa.fai)
D0=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="genome" && $2==0{printf "%.0f", $3}' genomecov.txt)
COVERED=$(awk -v g="$GEN" -v z="$D0" 'BEGIN{printf "%.0f", g-z}')
PCT=$(awk -v c="$COVERED" -v g="$GEN" 'BEGIN{printf "%.4f", 100*c/g}')
ALNB=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="genome"{s+=$2*$3} END{printf "%.0f", s}' genomecov.txt)
MEAN=$(awk -v a="$ALNB" -v g="$GEN" 'BEGIN{printf "%.4f", a/g}')
MAXD=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="genome"{if($2>m)m=$2} END{print m}' genomecov.txt)

{
  echo "genome_bases       $GEN   want == the .fai total ($FAI)   [cross-tool]"
  echo "per_contig_bases   $PER   want == genome_bases            [CONSERVATION]"
  echo "fai_contigs        $CONTIGS"
  echo "uncovered_bases    $D0"
  echo "covered_bases      $COVERED   ($PCT% of the genome at >=1x)"
  echo "aligned_bases      $ALNB   = sum(depth x bases)"
  echo "mean_depth         $MEAN   (observation; this library is ~1.5x)"
  echo "max_depth          $MAXD   (observation)"
  echo "wall_s             $WALL"
  echo "tmpfs_peak_used_mb $PEAK"
} > genomecov-smoke-check.txt
cat genomecov-smoke-check.txt
test "$GEN" = "$FAI"
test "$PER" = "$GEN"
awk -v d="$D0" -v g="$GEN" 'BEGIN{exit !(d>0 && d<g)}'
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
